objective: Use the supplied AI landscape transcript as an audit signal, compare its mechanisms with the existing current-first curriculum, and add only the missing reusable flows rather than publishing a transcript summary.

intent_correction.wrong_interpretation: Create and place a public HongLab landscape synthesis article.
intent_correction.correct_interpretation: Audit existing current topics against the transcript, retain sufficient paths, and write deep mechanism articles only for genuine gaps.

gap_decisions.reason: The existing route already exposes routing, active parameters, cache and hybrid sequence mechanisms.
Training-time reward, verifiers, preference learning and distillation already have independent mechanism coverage.
The curriculum already separates retrieval, context, tools, state and runtime orchestration.
Collection, extraction, deduplication, mixture design, verified synthesis and contamination were scattered but not one executable data contract.
Quantization and serving existed, but native low-bit training, MTP/runtime separation, resident memory and CPU/GPU/NPU placement lacked one device-budget route.
Signal foundations existed without the current audio-token, native speech-to-speech, realtime latency and turn-state system contract.
Classical model-based RL and robot foundations existed without a current bridge from video representation to action-conditioned latent prediction and closed-loop planning evidence.

source_intents.intent: Treat data curation as a controlled training intervention rather than an unmeasured cleanup step.
Ground extraction, filtering and deduplication in an inspectable open corpus pipeline.

source_intents.source: Textbooks Are All You Need II
source_intents.intent: Use synthetic textbook data as a bounded result, not a universal claim that clean data alone solves pretraining.
Separate native ternary-weight training from post-training quantization.

source_intents.source: Better and Faster LLMs via Multi-token Prediction
source_intents.intent: Separate a future-token training objective from an actual speculative verification runtime.
Anchor on-device architecture and effective resident parameter claims to a concrete official design.
Ground native omni speech architecture and multi-codebook generation in a public implementation.
Separate model latency from realtime transport, relay, jitter and session engineering.
Separate latent video representation, action-conditioned post-training and robot planning evidence.
Use interactive visual-world evidence without upgrading visual consistency into metric physics or robot-control proof.
Connect current omnimodal world foundation models to Physical AI while preserving task-specific evidence boundaries.

four_b_passes: Given one transcript claim and a route inventory excerpt, output retain, extend or add with one mechanism-based reason.
Given one primary source excerpt, extract claim, evidence level, assumptions and forbidden extrapolation into a fixed JSON packet.
Given one immutable equation, split it into aligned semantic rows while preserving every symbol and attach Korean operation labels.
Given one viewport defect packet, change one Viz or formula and return exact before/after measurements.
nine_b_passes: Merge 4-6 claim packets into one problem-to-mechanism article section without source-order summarization.
Build one current/canonical/concepts/foundations/stop/update research track from audited sources.
Check whether the article premises solve the private transfer problem and list uncovered premises only.
Design one interactive Viz with control, observable output, invariant, failure boundary and responsive states.
